messages.text:
Hi, I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed the DC06 over to me.

To point you the right way in one go:

1. How are you flashing it: SD card, USB, or the web UI upload?
2. What exactly happens, does it reject the file, hang at a percentage, or does the unit not come up at all after?

Tell me those two and we'll take it from there.
Searched the web · HarloSD flash Hammer DC06 firmware

Checked our Harlo OS page just now, and here is the likely answer.

The D.06 is not on the supported model list yet. Supported Hammers today are the BC04, DC02, DC08 and Thor P2. 
The list is 17 models from 7 manufacturers, and more get added most weeks, so not on the list yet means not yet rather than never.


So two possibilities:

1. The flasher has no DC06 option at all, which is the compatibility limit above.
2. You picked a model and it fails partway, which is usually a charge-only USB cable or the wrong browser. 
It needs Chrome or Edge and a USB data cable.


Which one is it: does DC06 show up in the model list on the flasher, or does it appear and then error out? If it errors, tell me the exact message.
